# CANDIDATE: VIX_LOW_OPENING_RANGE_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-09-05  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When VIX is low (<12) and the opening range is unusually tight (<0.2% of price), a breakout of that range in the direction of the prior day's close tends to persist, offering a directional edge. This setup captures volatility compression breakouts that occur when market participants are complacent, leading to sustained moves once the range is violated.

## Mechanism

Entry: If VIX < 12 AND (OR_high - OR_low) / open < 0.002 AND price breaks OR_high on a bar with volume > average_volume_20bars, then enter long at the close of the breakout bar.  
Exit: Initial stop at the tighter of OR_low or 0.5*ATR below entry. TP1 at 2R (risk-reward). Runner trails 10% off highest high since entry. Only trades during non‑news mornings (no FOMC, CPI, major earnings) and when prior day's close showed a clear trend (>0.4% move).
